=== Lead photograph (1 Nov 2026) ===
Bill named [https://www.linkedin.com/in/guy-kargl-eet-pmp-67a2835/ Guy Kargl, EET, PMP] as the 1997 Design-a-Card winner. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261101104014/https://swccg.com/snapshots/linkedin/guy-kargl.html Internet Archive]. Signed-in LinkedIn Experience lists Senior Design Engineer at XETA Technologies, Inc, May 1993 – Jul 2006, Broken Arrow, OK: designed printed circuit boards; assisted in creating a telephone switch (PBX); wrote software in Dataflex, HTML, and C. Broken Arrow is a Tulsa suburb. The 1997 Decipher contest article already names him a hardware and software design engineer from Tulsa. Cartoon lumberjack Facebook is not the dest. SSS Fence WWII founder Elden "Guy" is not the dest. [[S-foils]] stays in Photographs, not as the person lead.
